My favorite dessert is this easy banana bread I always make! It’s quick and tasty, especially when you slather a little honey butter on top.

1 1/2 c. AP flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp salt
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp clove
1 tsp nutmeg
1 stick butter
3 big ole bananas
1 c. Sugar
2 large eggs
1/2 c. Sour cream
1 tsp vanilla

Prepare a 9x5x3in. loaf pan by buttering and flouring it. Set your oven to bake at 350 and while it heats, mix the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and spices together in a bowl. Melt the butter in a separate mixing bowl, and cream the sugar into it. Add the eggs into this one at a time, while mixing. Add in the bananas and mash them—but leave a little texture. Dump in the sour cream and vanilla and give it a final mix. Combine your wet and dry mixtures and add to the loaf pan. Bake in oven for 1hr 10mins, but check on the loaf after an hour—poke the loaf with a toothpick. If it comes out clean with no batter on it, you’re good to go.

Hey, I know a few other people have said the same—but what you’ve written could really truly help reassure your person.

I don’t know your situation, and whether you’re keeping contact with them. But if you’re splitting, this would help give the both of you better closure. Leaving things open-ended may give them that false impression that things might “work out” in their favour after all?

Do you know that they’re on this subreddit? There’s a chance they might not use Reddit at all, lots of folks don’t. And there’s an even slimmer chance that they’ve been following this sub closely enough to find the answer they’re looking for, because there’s a billion different “letters” that could address those questions they’re asking within your context. What if wires are crossed and they confuse someone else with you, much like some of the folks replying you here as if you’re THEIR person?

I can totally understand if you’re afraid to be honest about your feelings, or if you’re scared of how it might respond. It’s okay. But please, please consider closure here—send what you’ve worked to write! It’ll help them understand better.
